title: umbimbi olubize incithakalo
intro: Zicabange uvikelekile ngaphansi kophahla olufanayo nesambulo, kodwa ukhetha ukwethembeka okuhlukile. Lo muntu wayephila eduze neqiniso kanye nomprofethi, kodwa waphendukela kulabo ababenqaba. Indaba yabo imi njengesixwayiso esiqinile sokuthi ukusondela ekulungeni kuphela akukwazi ukusindisa umphefumulo okhohlisa ithemba.
clues: Bengilazi iqiniso elalishunyayelwa ngumyeni wami, kodwa angizange ngilikholwe ngempela.
Ngamlahla ithemba lakhe ngokusekela abantu bakhe abamlahlayo nokubasiza ukuba bamelane naye.
Ngikhulunywe kanye nomlingani womunye umprofethi naye owakhaphela, njengesibonelo sabangakholwa.
Indaba yami ilandiswa kuSurah At-Tahrim njengesixwayiso sokuthi ubudlelwano nabaprofethi abuvikeli.
Ngabhubha kanye nabenzi bobubi lapho u-Allah ebhubhisa abantu bakaLut, ngasala nalabo abasalayo.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Wakhaphela umprofethi ngokusiza abangakholwa ukuba bamelane naye
Phonsa usana emfuleni ngebhasikidi ukuze ulusindise
Wafuna kwakhiwe ithole legolide ngesikhathi umprofethi engekho
Wamangalela umfundisi olungile ngokwenza okubi futhi wamvalela ejele
trial.answer: Wakhaphela umprofethi ngokusiza abangakholwa ukuba bamelane naye

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
